concept_en: The Direction of a Pawn-Chain Attack
question_cn: 法国防御中白方建立了e5-d4兵链（e5是链头，d4是链中），并追加了f4支撑。白方应该在哪一翼发动主攻？
question_en: In the French Defense, White has a pawn chain on e5-d4, supported by f4. On which wing should White launch the main attack?

options.text_cn: 后翼（a/b/c翼）——因为后翼空间更大
options.text_en: The queenside (a-, b-, or c-file), because there is more space there.
The center, by advancing d5 to lock the position.

options.text_cn: 王翼（f/g/h翼）——因为链头e5和f4都指向王翼方向
options.text_en: The kingside (f-, g-, or h-file), since the chain head on e5 and the pawn on f4 point that way.

options.text_cn: 随意，兵链方向与进攻翼无关
options.text_en: Either wing; the direction of the pawn chain is irrelevant.

explanation_cn: 兵链方向原则：沿链头所指方向发动进攻。e5-d4链的链头是e5，位于王翼一侧，因此白方应顺势沿f4→g4→h4方向在王翼推进。这一方向是兵链已经开路的方向，阻力最小、效率最高。反过来，黑方的链头d5指向后翼，所以黑方应在后翼（c5-b5方向）反击。
explanation_en: The pawn-chain principle is to attack in the direction of the chain head. White's chain head on e5 points toward the kingside, so White can advance there with f4-g4-h4, where the chain has already cleared a path. Black's chain head on d5 points toward the queenside, making a queenside counterattack with ...c5 and ...b5 logical.
